biotools.summary: CatReNet is an open-source Java application for interactive analysis of catalytic reaction networks, providing algorithms for computing autocatalytic subnetworks and dynamic visualizations for understanding complex biochemical systems. It's available on GitHub under a GPL3 license and has been published in Bioinformatics.
